name: Dougga / Thugga
description: Dougga is a hilltop ruined town in northern Tunisia, near Téboursouk, looking out over a wide farming plain. It began as a Libyco-Punic capital before thriving under Rome and Byzantium. Spread across 75 hectares of open countryside, it has escaped modern building, so you can wander a Roman theatre, the Capitol, temples and a towering Libyco-Punic mausoleum.
